purpose: Bounded full-primary access resolution and narrowly authorized static author-source inspection for MORGAN.

entries.verified_title: MORGAN: To Bridge Mixture of Experts and Spectral Graph Neural Network
entries.target_version: Published version of record registered by Crossref; full bytes not retrieved. No arXiv version established.
entries.saved_takeaway: The inspected Morgan path learns eigenvector-based band operators and gates them from mean eigenvalues, then filters node features X. Inspected constructors/training paths do not explicitly construct graph-filtered training residual/cotangent VJPs for expert-private parameter initialization.

relationship_to_GNNM_and_extension.shared_ancestry: Graph frequency-band expert construction and supervised graph learning.
relationship_to_GNNM_and_extension.candidate_specific_operation: Identical warm predictor with identity factors; fixed Bernstein bands filter masked training CE logit cotangent; parameter VJPs into active boundary R/S; centered g-orthogonal/capped private tangents with common descent; finite functional and Armijo checks; ordinary per-member continuation and fixed raw-logit pooling.
relationship_to_GNNM_and_extension.inspected_morgan_operation: Fresh spectral expert MLP/gate; continuous learned eigenvector-weight filtering of X followed by one fused predictor.
relationship_to_GNNM_and_extension.bounded_conclusion: Specific candidate initializer is not present in inspected Morgan constructors/training paths. This preserves an extension hypothesis; it does not establish originality or usefulness and is not full-paper absence evidence.

entries.attributed_prior_vs_open_gap: Attribute graph-spectrum experts and learned graph filtering. Candidate graph-filtered supervised cotangent-to-private-parameter initialization differs from inspected source; full-paper overlap and representative utility remain unresolved. Ancestry does not disqualify a supported extension.
entries.decisive_next_step: Retain this bounded source delta and full-paper access limit. Use separately qualified native MORGAN only if later intended; no runtime/native method/cost claim is established by this source inspection.

source_discrepancies.finding: Intro prose says AAAI2025 while 40th AAAI citation, author publications and DOI record support2026.
Only top-level Linear and Velocity children toggled. Morgan has no Velocity; expert/gate are nested modules, so these branches do not toggle them. No behavioral claim from execution.
GP branch constructs SLOG_B_gp and keeps same model/optimizer across parameter proposals, not a copied-ensemble expert initialization.
